WITH grouped AS (
  SELECT 
    o.timespan,
    AVG(CASE WHEN f.rebrate IS NOT NULL AND f.feerate IS NOT NULL AND f.feerate != 0 
             THEN f.rebrate / f.feerate END) as avg_ratio,
    COUNT(*) as match_count
  FROM fees f
  JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.timespan
),
avg_count_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(match_count) as avg_match_count
  FROM grouped
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT g.avg_ratio, g.match_count, ac.avg_match_count
  FROM grouped g
  CROSS JOIN avg_count_calc ac
  WHERE g.match_count > ac.avg_match_count
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_ratio) as avg_of_avg_ratios,
  SUM(match_count) as total_match_counts,
  AVG(match_count - avg_match_count) as avg_excess
FROM filtered
